accepted_source_properties: Only the current-process pseudohandle is used for working-set operations and creation identity; no foreign process is opened, signalled or modified and no child, Job, worker, helper or application is invoked.

Current-process token opens with TOKEN_QUERY only. TokenPrivileges is read into a bounded <=64KiB buffer with count, offset and entry-size checks; only three predeclared relevant privilege names/attributes are recorded. No token adjustment, privilege enable/grant, account or administrative change API exists in the source.

SetProcessWorkingSetSizeEx attempts minimum1MiB, maximum64MiB and HARDWS_MAX_ENABLE flag4 on this short-lived process. Success requires exact minimum/maximum readback, maximum enforcement present and maximum-disable flag8 absent; a second work-completion read must preserve those settings.

Initial and final work memory snapshots require current/peak working set and current/peak committed memory <=64MiB. An API failure is captured with immediate Winerror and failed status, never converted into support or qualification.
Work-finished elapsed time is captured and completion refuses >=2s. The 3.7s self-exit guard and final <4s acceptance remain; token handle is closed in finally and close failure refuses completion.

Pinned Windows Python3.11.15 and source hashes are rechecked; a fresh UUID32 owned receipt is no-clobber initially and atomically updated with <=16KiB encoded snapshots. Pending or failed output remains evidence.

primary_references.supports: Process working-set API signature, flag4 hard maximum, flag8 maximum disable, and privilege-dependent API failure semantics.
Minimum/maximum SIZE_T outputs and enforcement flag readback.
TOKEN_QUERY for privilege information and bounded return-buffer contract.
Privilege count plus variable LUID_AND_ATTRIBUTES array layout.
Read-only local lookup from known privilege name to LUID.

claim_limits: Source review does not prove this host supports the requested hard maximum without adjustment; the exact runtime result must be recorded.

A successful own-process diagnostic would qualify only this API observation. It does not repair Job working-set support, accept a new production helper design, prove launcher/worker inheritance, or admit native commands.
The diagnostic's process-local working-set state ends when that process exits; no persistent host privilege or account setting is requested.
execution_preconditions: Execute exactly the bound diagnostic bytes with pinned Windows Python3.11.15, a fresh UUID32 result in windows-working-set-r1 and an external four-second total watchdog.
Retain raw output and pending/failed receipt on every failure or timeout; verify the diagnostic's exact PID-plus-creation exit before any later action.
No privilege enabling/grant or production memory-ceiling change is authorized by this source acceptance.
All production helper changes, fixture passes, actual-root lifecycle/parity and original resource admission remain independently required.
